verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents shared mailboxes, team inboxes, or shared conversation state such as read, assigned, or handled status across team members. The only related item is delegated send-on-behalf, which is an adjacent permission feature rather than a shared inbox where everyone sees the same state, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
